materialization: Only the workspace run-id token and generated store keys may be allocated at setup. Persist the logical-to-physical map and fixture/source/test hashes before either paired arm. Every assertion compares exact logical identities after that bijective map; mappings cannot change an oracle. Seed with the existing maintained suite fixture adapters in isolated test stores, never the production namespace.

measurements.captureSequence: P001 implements missing measurement-only adapters and their independent failure controls first, before either product intervention or numeric baseline. This may extend existing recorder fields/instruments, never a second ledger. A planned field/probe is not present evidence. If any required dimension cannot be captured, that case is unknown and cannot pass. Baseline measurements may be newly run to fill a new missing case but never relabel or replace original failed b7df37fa.

foregroundLookup.definition: An agent-issued public canonical read/discovery/recovery call in the consumer turn; include graph:query, plans:get, work_items:get, goals:get, search:query/search:semantic and exact-recovery repeats; exclude internal nested adapter/store calls and test setup/control/ledger reads. No stream/body chunk is a new lookup.
foregroundLookup.selection: workspace_id=$W AND harness_slug=$H AND run_id=$consumerRunId AND coord_owner_id=$consumerOwner AND invoked_at >= $begin AND invoked_at < $settledEnd; match observed top-level transport/call_origin and exact tool_name/args_json; missing origin/run attribution => unknown. Compare with actual next-action transcript to prevent dropped calls.

measurements.pairing: Pre/post arms use identical fixture manifest hash, source fixture hash, test/runtime class/config and3 iterations. Begin at public consumer request admission; end only after evidence rendering or next actual action/halt and all child work/recorder drains settle. Capture durable operation source identity; incomplete capture is unknown, never zero.

plannedCaptureGaps.authoringAndSchema: Snapshot canonical projected input schemas and required sets at both source pins; normal field/description-only aliases do not hide a newly required value. Census every changed authority/result/acceptance path for new mandatory prose surfaces. Count actual typed record authoring calls and provider input/output tokens from matched model usage. The automated suite, not an agent checklist, emits the before/after census and exact added paths.
plannedCaptureGaps.durableAndStorage: Attach actual run-scoped counters at existing createDurableDispatch host.runStep and existing collector/store boundaries; record observed operation count and UTF8 bytes of actual persisted values once per attempt, including recovery. No inferred0 from absence of DBOS/query rows.
plannedCaptureGaps.purposeCounts: Extend existing recorder-owned provenance diagnostics with exact invocation/request identity and purpose derived from registered caller boundary (model/extraction/refresh/retrieval/authoring), not agent prose; missing unclassified calls=>unknown. repeatedCalls groups same normalized tool+args+scope after excluding deliberate case iteration.
plannedCaptureGaps.tokens: Decode final provider usage from the retained raw SSE via existing target-specific usage parser/llm-client; absence or partial tape=>unknown. Never replace missing usage with0. Bind every model request to parent run and purpose before comparison.

measurements.scalarResultStorage: Reuse each existing test_runs.execution_details.check.value/unit plus check.provenance.procedure/diagnostics, keyed by check.subject.ref=<edition>/<case>/<arm>/<iteration>/<dimension>. Source refs and exact query/adapter inputs are in provenance; no parallel table or agent-written measurement form.
measurements.unitsAndZero: Calls/steps/operations/fields/surfaces are counts; tokens are provider token counts; bytes are UTF8 bytes; latency is monotonic milliseconds. A measured0 requires an armed complete boundary with no matching effects, not an absent record. Each dimension independently<=110% of paired baseline median; baseline0 requires candidate0. All fixed action/correctness assertions must also pass.
